title: OSPF-to-EIGRP Redistribution Causing Loops
symptoms: Routes from OSPF are being advertised back into OSPF via EIGRP
Traceroute shows paths bouncing between two routers
CPU on both routers is elevated
Static routes exist but are not being filtered from redistribution
rootCause: Mutual redistribution between OSPF and EIGRP is configured without route tagging or filtering. Routes redistribute in a loop: OSPF -> EIGRP -> OSPF -> EIGRP. Route tags or distribute-lists are needed to prevent re-injection.

steps.prompt: Which command shows the redistribution configuration under both routing processes?
steps.hint: Look for 'redistribute eigrp' statements and any route-maps applied.

steps.prompt: Which command shows the OSPF external LSAs that were injected from EIGRP?
steps.hint: External LSAs should carry a route tag if filtering is configured.

steps.prompt: Which command shows the routing table to identify routes with incorrect next-hops?
steps.hint: Look for routes with next-hops pointing at the redistribution peer.
